title: MapView caps properties query at $top=2000 â€” silent truncation above that
detail: Line 63: `$top=2000` â€” hardcoded cap. Current scale is ~150 locations so not an issue. But if a customer onboards with 2500 sites, the map silently drops the last 500. No UI indication. Latent data-completeness risk.
recommendedFix: Keep the cap but add a warning banner when the result is exactly 2000: `if (locs.length === 2000) toast.show('warn', 'Map showing first 2000 locations â€” filter by customer to see the rest');`.
